sum: Penguin Solutions, Inc., an AI factory platform company, designs, builds, deploys, and manages data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers in the United States, China, Europe, Mexico, and internationally. Its full-stack AI factory platform combines infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate AI adoption, optimize token economics, and maximize return on AI investments. The company operates through three segments: Advanced Computing, Integrated Memory, and Optimized LED. The Advanced Computing segment provides AI and high-performance computing solutions under the Penguin Solutions and Penguin Computing brands, including ClusterWareAI AI factory operating system software, MemoryAI data center and AI inference solutions, ComputeAI GPU and CPU computing systems, and OriginAI reference architectures. It also offers high-availability and fault-tolerant computing solutions under Stratus brand. The Integrated Memory segment designs, develops, and delivers advanced memory and storage solutions that for AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, networking, and enterprise applications. It offers specialty memory and storage products under the SMART Modular Technologies product brand, including dynamic random access memory modules, solid-state and flash storage solutions, and CXL-based memory expansion technologies. This segment also provides customized supply chain planning and execution solutions. The Optimized LED segment offers application-optimized LED products that enable its customers to develop and market LED-based products for lighting, video displays and specialty lighting applications. The company was formerly known as SMART Global Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Penguin Solutions, Inc. in October 2024. Penguin Solutions, Inc. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Fremont, California.
